repro_commands:
# from the project folder
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -e ".[dev,docs]"
cd website; npm install; npm run build; cd ..
uvicorn afcr.api.app:app --port 8000      # website + API at http://localhost:8000
---
python -m pytest                                   # backend: unit + statistical tests (slow ones included)
cd website && npm test                              # frontend tests (vitest)
python scripts/run_tests_report.py                  # writes results/processed/test_report.json (shown on this site)
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m afcr.experiments.suite --trials 30 --workers 6      # all synthetic experiment groups
python -m afcr.experiments.suite --groups main,budget_curve --trials 10              # a subset
python scripts/make_figures.py                      # 18 figures + manifest, from real objects / result files
python scripts/build_docs.py                        # paper, report, status (numbers read from results/)
python scripts/build_deck.py                        # presentation/research_presentation.pptx
python scripts/build_pdfs.py                        # PDF exports of paper and report
---
{
  "kind": "automaton", "n_states": 48, "eps_plan": 0.6,       // instance family and planted-fault probability
  "method": "lucb_prefix",                                      // lucb | lucb_prefix | successive_elim | uniform_fc | random_fc | ...
  "delta": 0.1, "budget": 60000, "eps": 0.0,                    // confidence, rollout cap, argmax tolerance
  "target": "argmax", "conf": "stack_kl",                       // or first_above / last_above with "theta"
  "intervention": "repair", "recon_noise": 0.0, "seed": 20000   // instance seed; algorithm RNG uses seed + 7
}
---
# .env (see .env.example) — optional, unused in synthetic mode
OPENAI_API_KEY=
OPENAI_BASE_URL=
